title: Lakewood-Amedex Biotherapeutics Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Lakewood-Amedex Biotherapeutics Inc., a micro-cap biotech company listed on Nasdaq (ticker: LABT), filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026 announcing the appointment of Dr. Joseph Tucker to its Board of Directors. Dr. Tucker, a veteran biotech executive with experience at Enveric Biosciences, VirTech Bio, Willow Biosciences, and Stem Cell Therapeutics, will serve until the 2027 annual meeting. Compensation includes $6,000 per quarter in stock and 33,784 warrants with a $10.00 exercise price vesting over two years.
key_points: Dr. Joseph Tucker appointed to Board of Directors effective April 24, 2026
Dr. Tucker previously CEO of Enveric Biosciences (NASDAQ: ENVB) since September 2021
Compensation: $6,000/quarter payable in common stock plus 33,784 warrants at $10.00 exercise price
Warrants vest in four equal tranches: Oct 2026, Apr 2027, Oct 2027, Apr 2028
Company is an emerging growth company under SEC definitions
Trading on Nasdaq under symbol LABT; registered in Nevada
